source: The reason why EPSP summation occurs only at very high motoneuron firing frequencies (120 Hz) in ∆I–IIA, but already at 60 Hz in controls and in ∆I–IIB animals is a significantly smaller EPSP half-width upon excision of the I–IIA exon (Figure 6R).
